paper_title: Limits on new long range nuclear spin-dependent forces set with a K-3He co-magnetometer
notes: Fig.4 shows limit on (g_p^n)^2/(4pi) vs pseudoscalar boson mass (x-axis in meV). Massless value (g_p^n)^2/(4pi)<5.8e-10 is the robust reported number; flat below m~4e-7 eV (range set by 50 cm distance) then rises exponentially. Rising points are digitized approximations from the exp(mr) behavior. Values emitted are the paper's (g_p^n)^2/(4pi), NOT converted to dimensionless g_an; downstream must take sqrt(4pi*value) to get g_an. This is a spin-spin (dipole-dipole) force between neutrons via a pseudoscalar; also reports vector/torsion/unparticle bounds (Table I) not extracted here. Laboratory force search, not a DM haloscope, so no local density assumed. 1-sigma limit reported. | selector: text (sole candidate) | axis-peek for confusable-family text read (#625 Phase 3c)
